description: This Java source file defines the class `ContactMechServices` which provides service methods for managing contact mechanisms in the OFBiz framework. It includes functionalities for creating, updating, and deleting contact mechanisms such as postal addresses, telecom numbers, emails, and associated purposes. The class handles security checks, data validation, and interaction with the database through OFBiz's delegator and entity system.

classes.name: ContactMechServices
classes.description: A utility class providing service methods for managing contact mechanisms (addresses, phone numbers, emails) in the OFBiz platform, including creation, update, deletion, and purpose assignment.

methods.name: createContactMech
methods.description: Creates a new contact mechanism (address, phone, email, etc.) for a party, performs security validation, generates IDs, and stores relevant data.

methods.name: updateContactMech
methods.description: Updates an existing contact mechanism by creating a new record with updates and marking the old as expired, respecting security checks.

methods.name: deleteContactMech
methods.description: Marks a contact mechanism as 'thruDate' to simulate deletion, with appropriate security validation.

methods.name: createPostalAddress
methods.description: Creates a postal address contact mechanism, storing address details and associating with a party.

methods.name: updatePostalAddress
methods.description: Updates an existing postal address contact mechanism with new address details.

methods.name: createTelecomNumber
methods.description: Creates a telecom number contact mechanism with country, area codes, and number.

methods.name: updateTelecomNumber
methods.description: Updates details of an existing telecom number contact mechanism.

methods.name: createEmailAddress
methods.description: Creates an email address contact mechanism by wrapping createContactMech and setting type accordingly.

methods.name: updateEmailAddress
methods.description: Updates email address contact mechanism by wrapping updateContactMech with email-specific type.

methods.name: createPartyContactMechPurpose
methods.description: Associates a purpose (e.g., billing, shipping) with a party contact mechanism, ensuring no duplicates within valid date ranges.

methods.name: getPartyContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanism value maps for a party, optionally including historical (old) contact mechanisms.

methods.name: copyPartyContactMechs
methods.description: Copies contact mechanisms and their purposes from one party to another, creating new records for the target party.

methods.name: createEmailAddressVerification
methods.description: Generates a verification hash for an email address and creates an email verification record with expiry.
